subject: Information Theory
title: Swarm Intelligence
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Swarm Intelligence.

hook.text: A single ant is nearly brainless. A colony solves complex routing problems. Intelligence emerges from information flow.

buildup.text: Ants share information through pheromone trails. Stronger trails attract more ants, creating positive feedback loops.

discovery.text: The colony implements a distributed algorithm: each ant follows simple rules, but the swarm computes optimal paths.

twist.text: Ant colony optimization—inspired by real ants—now solves routing problems in telecommunications networks.

climax.text: Swarm intelligence shows that information distributed across simple agents can produce complex collective computation.

punchline.text: Simple agents, shared signals, smart swarm. Information flows upward.

quiz.question: How do ant colonies achieve complex problem-solving?
options: Distributed information sharing through pheromone feedback
